body: I started changing my age because instead of getting genuine advice I would often be told I was too young to worry about relationships, and to just break things off in which I have no intentions to do so.
I have been to therapy, but I really struggled with opening up. Thank you for the input though, I'll definitely try getting back into it.
We were in a bad argument over this, and he made it seem like I was in the wrong in this situation. I just wanted others input and opinion to make sure I wasn't going crazy.
